# ImPossible Psychological Services

> > Affordable psychotherapy and counselling services in Singapore offering CBT, systemic family therapy, and specialized treatments for adults, couples, children, and organizations.

ImPossible Psychological Services is a Singapore-based mental health clinic located on Joo Chiat Road, providing evidence-based psychological services delivered by qualified clinical psychologists and counselors. The practice specializes in cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), schema therapy, and choice theory approaches to address mental health concerns across all age groups and organizational settings.

## Key Topics

- CBT (Cognitive Behavior Therapy)
- Schema Therapy
- Systemic Family Therapy
- CTRT (Choice Theory and Reality Therapy)
- Psychological Assessment
- Adult Counselling
- Couple Therapy
- Child and Adolescent Services
- Depression Therapy
- Art Therapy
- ADHD
- Corporate Wellness
- Mental Health Singapore
- Joo Chiat Road Clinic
- Psychotherapy Services

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://www.impossiblepsychservices.com.sg/our-services): Main services overview covering adult, couple, child counselling, psychological assessment, art therapy, and corporate wellness.
- [Adult Counselling Services](https://www.impossiblepsychservices.com.sg/our-services/adult-counselling-service): Individual and group therapy for anxiety, depression, and mental health concerns in adults.
- [Couple Therapy and Marriage Counselling](https://www.impossiblepsychservices.com.sg/our-services/couple-therapy-and-marriage-counselling): Relationship therapy addressing couples issues and strengthening partnerships.
- [Child and Adolescent Services](https://www.impossiblepsychservices.com.sg/our-services/child-and-adolescent-services): Therapy for ADHD, dyslexia, autism spectrum disorders, and behavioral issues in children and teenagers.
- [Depression Therapy](https://www.impossiblepsychservices.com.sg/our-services/therapy-for-depression): Specialized depression therapy with expert therapists offering professional and compassionate treatment.
- [Psychological Testing and Assessment](https://www.impossiblepsychservices.com.sg/our-services/psychological-testing): Comprehensive psychological assessment for ADHD, dyslexia, dyscalculia, giftedness, and personality evaluation.
- [Art Therapy](https://www.impossiblepsychservices.com.sg/our-services/art-therapy): Creative expression therapy for depression, anxiety, trauma, and self-esteem building.
- [Corporate Services](https://www.impossiblepsychservices.com.sg/our-services/corporate-services): Employee assistance programmes and organizational workshops for workplace mental health and wellness.
